exposure: Intramuscular 17-alpha hydroxyprogesterone caproate (250 mg once a week)
outcome: First and fifth minute Apgar score
cohort: The study included 108 pregnant women experiencing threatened preterm labor who had received tocolytic therapy, with gestational ages ranging from 24 to 34 weeks.
finding: Vaginal progesterone suppositories were found to decrease the rate of preterm delivery and improve newborn outcomes (birth weight and Apgar scores) more effectively than intramuscular 17-alpha-hydroxyprogesterone caproate.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight was 2685.18 g in the intramuscular progesterone group and 2999.25 g in the vaginal suppository group.
gest_age: 24-34 weeks at the time of threatened preterm labor
